descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S11 Account kind x code x disabled -> who gets in

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Sign-in is by email one-time passcode only: no password field and no shared or static PIN anywhere. The only exception is the two app review accounts, which use a fixed code. (UAT OAT-01 step 1; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • T4 App review accounts: exactly two designated emails (appconnect-test-account@roundcompanion.com, playstore-test-account@roundcompanion.com) accept a fixed, reusable code that never expires. … (TFA-94513 AC 15; TFA-94513 AC 16; UAT OAT-01 Expected) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U9 Disabling a physician turns their access off immediately on every device, even without a separate revoke call. Disabling and revoking signs them out immediately, and they cannot request a new code. … (UAT OAT-01 step 9; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 8; TFA-94513 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Ordinary and disabled-ordinary cells: a non-dev deployment that can send real mail (Q11), with @roundai.test or team accounts only. Review-account cells (fixed code, the review accounts' mock patients, a disabled review account): only on a non-dev QA deployment, run by Tim. …

When Try each cell: ordinary + emailed code; ordinary + 000000; each review email + fixed code (twice, and again a day later); another roundcompanion.com address + 000000 (non-dev QA deployment only); disabled ordinary + Send sign-in code; disabled ordinary + a code issued just before the disable; …

Then In: ordinary + emailed code; each review email + fixed code, every time, with no expiry. Refused: ordinary + 000000; any other address + 000000; disabled + new code request (no code is sent); disabled + pre-issued code; disabled review account. Disabled only: the next call from each signed-in session is refused and the open tab lands on sign-in. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94513 AC 1, 14, 15 per cell, and UAT 'except the two app review accounts' and 'Disabling an account turns access off immediately'. Any refused cell that gets in = Fail. Known on main (TFA-94513 snapshot): one other address is accepted (store-review-test-account@), and its fixed code is generated per Send request with expiresIn 300 and one-time use (convex/lib/emailOtpAuth. …

Where it ran: dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
